description: This script is designed to detect unresolved merge conflict markers in tracked files within a Git repository. It checks files for conflict marker lines such as '<<<<<<< ', '=======', and '>>>>>>> ', and reports any that contain such conflicts, aiding in cleanup before commits or merges.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data by detecting byte 0.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Identifies lines that contain conflict markers in a given content string.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Returns a list of tracked files in the current Git repository.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks multiple files for conflict marker lines and reports violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates detection of conflict markers and outputs results.
